You may cast any force power that deals lightning damage using either Wisdom or Charisma as its forcecasting ability.

You can also reshape a damage-dealing force power that calls for a force attack or a saving throw so that it deals lightning damage instead. Doing so converts any saving throw the power calls for into a Dexterity saving throw. If the attack hits, or the target fails that save, each affected creature becomes shocked until the start of your next turn.

You can use this ability twice, gaining one additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. All uses are restored after a short or long rest.
